description: This source file defines a class 'SettingsWindowOpener' responsible for managing the opening of the settings or preferences window in a macOS application. It includes mechanisms to register a custom open settings action or fallback to the default menu actions if none is registered.

classes.name: SettingsWindowOpener
classes.description: A singleton class that manages opening the application's settings or preferences window, either via a registered action or by invoking default menu actions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a custom OpenSettingsAction to be invoked when opening the settings window.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Activates the application and attempts to open the settings window via the registered action or fallback menu actions.
